name: Chuzhoj dom
source: The earthly world and the otherworldly world are eerily intertwined in the mind of the protagonist of this story. Which of the worlds is the real one? Not only the fate of the main character will depend on the choice made, but also, perhaps, the fate of both worlds.
translation: 在这个故事的主人公的心中，尘世世界和超凡脱俗的世界诡异地交织在一起。哪个世界才是真实的世界？不仅主角的命运将取决于所做的选择，而且也许还取决于两个世界的命运。
